title: Four notes only
prompt: Write a riff using only four different notes. Any key, any tempo. Make it stick in people's heads.

title: Clean and sad
prompt: No distortion this week. Play the saddest clean riff you can. Reverb is allowed, crying is optional.

title: One string
prompt: Write a riff on one string only. Slides, bends and hammer-ons all count.

title: Fuzz wall
prompt: Pick the fuzziest preset you can find and play something slow and heavy. Let it ring.

title: Funk it
prompt: Sixteenth-note funk rhythm. Muted strums, tight timing, wah if you have one in your chain.

title: Drop the tuning
prompt: Tune down (or use the pitch pedal) and play your heaviest riff. Bonus points for a breakdown.

title: Blues in A
prompt: Twelve bars, key of A. Play the rhythm or a solo over it, your call.

title: Ambient swell
prompt: Volume swells, long delay, big reverb. Make a soundscape that lasts at least 30 seconds.

title: Two chords
prompt: Only two chords, the whole clip. Make it interesting with rhythm and dynamics.

title: Gallop
prompt: Gallop picking riff (one-and-a, one-and-a). Palm mute it and keep it tight.

title: Lo-fi bedroom
prompt: Make it sound like an old cassette. Lo-fi preset, soft playing, warm and wobbly.

title: Riff from your city
prompt: Play something that sounds like where you live. Local scale, local rhythm, local vibe.

title: Bass line
prompt: Bass players' week. Guitarists, play it an octave down or use a bass preset. Groove first.

title: Harmonics
prompt: Use natural or pinch harmonics as the hook of your riff.

title: Odd time
prompt: Write a riff in 7/8 or 5/4. Count it out loud if you need to.

title: Same riff, three tones
prompt: Play one riff three times: clean, crunch and high gain. Show how the tone changes the feel.

title: Slide
prompt: Slide guitar or lots of slides. Bottleneck, lighter, finger, whatever you have.

title: Ten seconds
prompt: Your whole riff has to fit in ten seconds. Short and catchy wins.

title: Arpeggios
prompt: No strumming. Pick each note of the chord. Chorus or delay makes it shimmer.

title: Video game
prompt: Write an original riff that would fit a boss fight. Fast, dramatic, a bit over the top.

title: Reverse it
prompt: Take one of your own riffs and play it backwards, last note first. Keep what sounds good.

title: Unplugged feel
prompt: Use the cleanest preset and play it like an acoustic. Fingerpicking welcome.

title: Power chords only
prompt: Nothing but power chords. Make them hit hard with timing and palm muting.

title: Call and response
prompt: A riff that asks a question, then answers it. Two halves, one idea.

title: Wah week
prompt: Put the wah in your chain and build the riff around it.

title: Your first riff
prompt: Play the first riff you ever learned, then play your own version of it with a Riff House tone.
